product.title: See the City Segway Tour

description.text: Glide through Washington, D.C. on a two-and-a-half-hour Segway tour with stops at the White House, Lincoln Memorial, and Pennsylvania Avenue viewpoints. After a training session, your guide leads a paced route along National Mall paths and downtown corridors with commentary on monuments and federal landmarks. Segways and helmets are included with instruction for first-time riders. This active sightseeing format covers more ground than a walking tour in less time.

highlights: Segway tour of DC monuments and downtown
Training session and safety briefing included
White House and Lincoln Memorial stops
National Mall riding route with guide commentary

start.description: Meet at the Segway staging area near the National Mall confirmed when booking. Allow time for training.

end.description: Return Segways to the staging area after the final downtown stop.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the See the City Segway Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Washington, D.C.?
faqs.answer: Meet at the Segway staging area near the National Mall confirmed when booking. Allow time for training.
